purpose: Stage 2 drug-perturbation model candidate (deployed): Conditional Monge Gap transport model

sources.method: git clone <url> source/ && git -C source checkout <commit> && rm -rf source/.git

notes: Deployed model; no pretrained weights by design (per-dataset HVG output; RDKit structure + dose conditioning; ~23k params). `source/{assets,data,models}` are the demo data and embeddings bundled in the upstream repository (download/manual.md: "cmonge/data/ — bundled demo data"). Absorbed from the deleted VALIDATION.md: the official scripts/demo_train.py fails immediately because configs/demo_config.yml contains the author macOS path /Users/alicedriesen/Projects/conditional-monge; after replacing that path in a copy the demo completed end-to-end on CPU (AE train -> CMonge 100 iters -> evaluate) with mean R2 0.8865 (abexinostat-10), 0.9199 (belinostat-10), 0.8919 (dacinostat-10). The 1.3 GB `.venv` in the old tree was a duplicate of stage2/_envs/cmonge and was deleted in ticket 04. Environment records: the tracked lock pair (`stage2/01_setup/cmonge/env.lock` and `stage2/_envs/cmonge.lock`) is a 2026-10 record — its editable pin was rewritten from the old model path to `pert_model/CMonge/source` (ruling B2); the environments are already built, so the lock is not re-resolved here.
